verdict.rationale: Zoho documents two natural-language paths: the built-in Zia assistant ("Ask Zia in plain English") and Zoho MCP, which links Books to LLMs like Claude to "create invoices, track payments, and pull reports just by asking." The vendor page also quotes customers running bookkeeping through "simple AI-driven instructions." missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-quoted testimonials, documentation of which Books actions Zia can execute versus only answer, and a detailed list of the Books operations the sign-in-gated MCP service exposes.
